Test Steps: Open app and wait for launch flow.
Expected Result: Launch screen appears briefly then Login opens.

Preconditions: Verified patient, admin and IT accounts exist.
Test Steps: Sign in separately with each role.
Expected Result: Patient/admin/IT land on their matching dashboard.

Test Steps: Submit blank fields, malformed email, then wrong password.
Expected Result: Invalid input is blocked and Firebase authentication failure is shown.

Test Steps: Enter valid name/email/phone/matching password and register.
Expected Result: Auth account and patient profile are created; verification is requested.

Test Steps: Try empty fields, invalid email, 9/11 digit phone and mismatched passwords.
Test Data: Invalid fields one at a time
Expected Result: Validation prevents submit and shows field errors.

Test Steps: Register again using existing email.
Expected Result: Firebase rejects duplicate account and error feedback appears.

Test Steps: Submit correct code.
Expected Result: emailVerified becomes true and patient can proceed.

Preconditions: Account exists; code can be wrong/expired/missing.
Test Steps: Submit wrong, expired and missing codes.
Expected Result: Wrong increments attempts; expired/missing are rejected.

Test Steps: Request password reset.
Expected Result: Firebase reset email request succeeds with confirmation feedback.

Test Steps: Submit blank and malformed email.
Expected Result: Invalid value is rejected or failure feedback is shown.

Test Steps: Open dashboard and inspect appointment summary.
Expected Result: Patient-specific summary and appointment navigation appear.

Test Steps: Open Upcoming appointments.
Expected Result: Own confirmed upcoming appointment is listed.

Test Steps: Open Past appointments.
Expected Result: Past/completed appointment is listed.

Test Steps: Open its details.
Expected Result: Selected appointment fields are displayed.

Preconditions: Two test patients; know other patient's appointment ID.
Test Steps: As patient A, try to load patient B appointment.
Expected Result: No foreign patient data is exposed; verify Firestore rules, not only route behavior.

Preconditions: Own appointment and matching queue exist.
Test Steps: Open Queue Status and wait for listener.
Expected Result: Appointment token, current/next token and status appear.

Preconditions: Patient and admin clients subscribed to same queue.
Test Steps: Change currentToken in admin client and observe patient client without reload.
Expected Result: Patient queue view updates from Firestore snapshot.

Preconditions: Own appointment is near next token.
Test Steps: Open status and advance queue into notification threshold.
Expected Result: Turn-approaching in-app notification is created once for appointment.

Preconditions: Verified patient; active doctor and open OPD.
Test Steps: Select doctor/date/session and confirm booking.
Expected Result: Appointment links patient, doctor, OPD, token and confirmation notification.

Test Steps: Attempt to confirm booking.
Expected Result: Booking service rejects booking and feedback appears.

Preconditions: Doctor schedule and OPD sessions exist.
Test Steps: Choose allowed date/session and available slot.
Expected Result: Only valid schedule and unreserved slots can be booked.

Preconditions: A confirmed booking occupies a slot.
Test Steps: Reload options and attempt occupied slot.
Expected Result: Slot is unavailable and overlapping booking is rejected.

Test Steps: Open list and mark notification read.
Expected Result: Firestore isRead changes and subscribed list updates.

Test Steps: Delete it from list and reload.
Expected Result: Record is deleted and disappears from list.

Test Steps: Open status screen.
Expected Result: Current status and delay details are shown.

Preconditions: Screen open; admin can change delay.
Test Steps: Change delay in admin and observe patient view.
Expected Result: Patient status reflects Firestore update without reload.

Test Steps: Open profile.
Expected Result: Signed-in patient's saved profile is shown.

Test Steps: Set language to Sinhala and reopen app.
Expected Result: Preference persists; record which UI strings are translated.

Test Steps: Edit name and phone then reload.
Expected Result: Profile updates persist to user profile.

Preconditions: Admin signed in; today's appointments/queues exist.
Test Steps: Open dashboard and inspect patient/queue summary.
Expected Result: Available counts and queue summary display; report export is not assumed.

Test Steps: Open appointment list and find today's record.
Expected Result: Appointment and current status are displayed.

Test Steps: Change status to completed/cancelled.
Expected Result: Firestore status changes and live list reflects it.

Preconditions: Valid OPD and schedule; admin signed in.
Test Steps: Create doctor and reopen list/booking flow.
Expected Result: Doctor is saved and available in list/booking selection.

Test Steps: Submit missing name/department/room, invalid dates/slot, duplicate name.
Expected Result: Validation blocks save and identifies field issue.

Test Steps: Edit schedule, then delete doctor and refresh list.
Expected Result: Changes persist; doctor is removed. Verify historical appointment snapshots separately.

Test Steps: Create queue and assign nurse where offered.
Expected Result: Queue starts waiting and stores location and token capacity.

Test Steps: Start, pause, resume and end queue.
Expected Result: Each status persists and matching status label/color appears.

Test Steps: Complete next patient; cancel/no-show another eligible patient.
Expected Result: Disposition is recorded and current/next tokens advance using pending tokens.

Test Steps: Delete queue then refresh patient/admin views.
Expected Result: Queue record is removed; appointment records are separately verified.

Test Steps: Select both and broadcast delay.
Expected Result: Delay record is created and patient clinic view updates.

Test Steps: Submit without doctor or delay selection.
Expected Result: Request is blocked with prompt to select required values.

Preconditions: IT role and system records available.
Test Steps: Open dashboard.
Expected Result: Monitoring and latest backup/maintenance summaries load.

Test Steps: Run monitoring and diagnostics.
Expected Result: Service status and measured response time appear.

Preconditions: IT screen open; simulate Firestore unavailable.
Test Steps: Run checks offline/with denied access.
Expected Result: Diagnostic reports unavailable/critical; failure log is attempted.

Test Steps: Filter lists and open a log detail.
Expected Result: Matching logs/details appear; resolved logs excluded from open lists.

Test Steps: Change open to investigating then resolved.
Expected Result: Status persists and resolvedAt is set on resolution.

Test Steps: Update its status.
Expected Result: Firestore failure is surfaced; no other record is changed.

Test Steps: Create maintenance, inspect history and update status.
Expected Result: Record and status appear in history.

Test Steps: Submit missing title or end before start.
Expected Result: Invalid record is not accepted; note if form lacks validation.

Test Steps: Run manual backup action and inspect history/status.
Expected Result: Metadata record changes running to completed; this is not data export/restore.

Test Steps: Open latest backup/history.
Expected Result: No success is claimed without a valid completed backup record.

Preconditions: Test Firebase project; email delivery; patient/admin clients.
Test Steps: Register, verify, book; admin starts/calls next; patient checks status and notification.
Expected Result: Booking appears for admin; patient sees queue update and notification when threshold reached.

Test Steps: Create OPD/doctor; book as patient; create/start queue; update token.
Expected Result: Patient can book new schedule and sees its matching live queue.

Preconditions: Patient appointment and admin queue exist.
Test Steps: Patient checks in; admin completes patient; inspect both views.
Expected Result: Appointment check-in/status and queue token outcome remain consistent.

Test Steps: Book; read from subscription; cancel; check record and slot.
Expected Result: Booking is stored/read; cancellation updates status and releases slot.

Test Steps: Attempt cancel/delete on another patient's or nonexistent appointment.
Expected Result: Rules prevent foreign writes; missing ID errors/no-op. Test deployed rules separately.

Test Steps: Create, read, mark read, delete; retry update/delete with unknown ID.
Expected Result: Valid changes appear; invalid IDs fail without changing unrelated records.

Test Steps: Create on registration; read/update profile; try missing UID update.
Expected Result: Profile persists; missing-user behavior is recorded.

Test Steps: Create/read/update/delete queue; retry update/delete with invalid IDs.
Expected Result: Valid mutations appear live; invalid ID does not mutate unrelated queues.

Test Steps: Create delay; read by doctor and all-doctor query; query unknown doctor.
Expected Result: Created delay is returned; unknown doctor yields no match. Delay update/delete is not implemented.

Test Steps: Create; read list/detail/summary; resolve; attempt update with missing ID.
Expected Result: Valid status persists; missing ID fails. Error log delete is not implemented.

Test Steps: Create/read/update backup and maintenance; update missing IDs.
Expected Result: Valid record changes persist; missing record update fails. Delete is not implemented.

Preconditions: Admin; valid and invalid department, nurse and senior consultant data.
Test Steps: Create/read/edit/delete OPD and staff records; repeat with blank required fields and missing IDs.
Test Data: Valid records; invalid values; unknown IDs
Expected Result: Valid CRUD is reflected in Firestore/list; invalid create is rejected; missing update/delete does not affect another record.

Preconditions: Test appointment exists; service-level test account.
Test Steps: Call appointment delete operation and verify record is absent; retry with unknown ID.
Expected Result: Existing appointment document is deleted; missing ID has no unintended effect.

Test Steps: Submit rating/comment; read feedback for patient; repeat with valid minimum rating and empty optional comment.
Expected Result: Feedback is saved with patient/appointment IDs and can be read for that patient.
